body:
# 🌌 VoidSafe: No More Void Death

Ever fallen into the void and lost all your precious items? Tired of that terrifying moment when you slip through the bedrock and watch your health bar disappear? This mod completely removes the fear of falling into the void!

**VoidSafe** makes the void completely harmless - you can fall forever without taking damage, hearing that dreadful hit sound, or experiencing the screen shake. Perfect for builders who want to explore the void, create floating structures, or just want a more forgiving Minecraft experience.

Since this is a **simple utility mod**, it focuses on doing one thing perfectly - removing void damage - without adding unnecessary complexity or affecting any other game mechanics.

---

## ⭐ Core Features

This mod doesn't add any new blocks or items - it simply removes the danger from the void:

### 🛡️ Total Void Protection
The void becomes your friend! You can now fall into it without any consequences:
- **No damage taken** - Your health bar stays completely intact
- **No hit sounds** - That awful "thump" sound is completely removed
- **No screen shake** - Your camera stays perfectly smooth
- **Infinite falling** - Fall forever without any negative effects

### ⚡ Lightweight & Clean
- **Pure event handling** - Works by intercepting void damage events
- **No performance impact** - Minimal code, maximum efficiency
- **No new blocks/items** - Pure vanilla behavior modification
- **Server-friendly** - Works in both singleplayer and multiplayer

---

## 🎯 Perfect For

- **Void builders** - Create floating bases and structures in the void
- **Explorers** - Safely explore the area below bedrock
- **Technical players** - Build complex farms and contraptions without fear
- **Casual players** - Remove the stress of accidentally falling
- **Modpack creators** - Add a quality-of-life feature to your modpack
- **Adventure maps** - Create custom void-based challenges

---

## 🤔 FAQ

**Q: Will I stop falling?**  
A: No, you'll keep falling. The mod only removes the damage, not the physics.

**Q: Can I build in the void?**  
A: Yes! The mod makes void-building completely safe.

**Q: Does this work in the Nether?**  
A: Yes, it works in all dimensions (Overworld, Nether, End).

**Q: Will other mobs be protected?**  
A: No, only players are protected from void damage.

**Q: Is this a cheat?**  
A: It's a quality-of-life mod that removes frustration. Use it as you see fit!

**Q: Can I use this on a server?**  
A: Yes, but you'll need to install it on the server and all clients.
